q: Which animal says woof?
x: Dogs say woof! They love to play.

q: Which animal says meow?
x: Cats say meow, and they purr when they are happy.

q: Which animal says quack?
x: Ducks say quack and love to swim.

q: Which animal has a very long neck?
x: Giraffes use their long necks to eat leaves from tall trees.

q: Which animal has a trunk?
x: An elephant uses its trunk to drink and to pick things up.

q: Who lives in the water?
x: Fish live in water and swim with their fins.

q: Which animal hops?
x: Rabbits hop with their strong back legs.

q: Who gives us eggs?
x: Hens lay eggs.

q: What is a baby dog called?
x: A baby dog is called a puppy.

q: Which animal is the slowest?
x: Snails are very slow - they carry their house on their back.

q: Which animal has black and white stripes?
x: Zebras have black and white stripes.

q: Which insect makes honey?
x: Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.

q: Where does a bird live?
x: Many birds build nests in trees.

q: What do we see with?
x: We see with our eyes.

q: What do we hear with?
x: We hear with our ears.

q: What do we smell with?
x: We smell with our nose.

q: What do we walk with?
x: We walk with our feet.

q: What do we clap with?
x: We clap with our hands.

q: What do we brush every morning and night?
x: Brushing our teeth keeps them clean and strong.

q: What do we taste with?
x: We taste food with our tongue.

q: Which one is a fruit?
x: An apple is a fruit - it grows on a tree.

q: Which fruit is yellow and long?
x: Bananas are yellow, and we peel them before we eat them.

q: What do we drink that comes from a cow?
x: Cows give us milk, and milk helps our bones grow strong.

q: Which one is a vegetable?
x: Carrots are vegetables that grow under the ground.

q: Which snack is the healthiest?
x: Fruit is a healthy snack that gives us energy.

q: Which fruit is red and has seeds on the outside?
x: Strawberries have tiny seeds on the outside!

q: What do we use when it rains?
x: An umbrella keeps us dry in the rain.

q: What do we wear when it is cold?
x: A warm coat keeps us warm in winter.

q: What falls from the clouds when it is very cold?
x: When it is very cold, snow falls.

q: When do we see the Moon and stars?
x: We see the Moon and stars at night.

q: What does the Sun give us?
x: The Sun gives us light and keeps us warm.

q: What do we do before we eat?
x: Washing our hands keeps germs away.

q: Where do we sleep?
x: We sleep in our cosy bed.

q: What do we wear on our feet?
x: Shoes keep our feet safe.

q: What do we wear on our head?
x: A hat keeps the sun off our head.

q: What do we use to cut paper?
x: Scissors cut paper - always use them carefully!

q: What do we eat soup with?
x: We eat soup with a spoon.

q: Who helps us when we are sick?
x: A doctor helps us get better.

q: Who puts out fires?
x: Firefighters put out fires and keep us safe.

q: How do we cross the street safely?
x: Always hold a grown-up's hand when you cross the street.

q: What colour is grass?
x: Grass is green.

q: What colour is the sky on a sunny day?
x: On a sunny day the sky is blue.

q: Which one is red?
x: A strawberry is red.

q: Which one is round like a ball?
x: An orange is round like a ball.

q: Which one is the biggest?
x: An elephant is much bigger than a mouse.

q: Which one is hot?
x: Fire is very hot - never touch it!

q: Which one is cold?
x: Ice cream is cold, and it melts in the sun.

q: Which one is the smallest?
x: Ants are tiny, but they are very strong.

q: Which one flies in the sky?
x: Airplanes fly high in the sky.

q: Which one goes on water?
x: Boats float on water.

q: Which one runs on tracks?
x: Trains run on long metal tracks.

q: What do plants need to grow?
x: Plants need water and sunlight to grow.

q: Where do apples grow?
x: Apples grow on trees.

q: What grows from a seed?
x: A little seed grows into a plant.

q: In which season does it snow?
x: In winter it is cold, and snow can fall.

q: Which animal says hoo-hoo at night?
x: Owls are awake at night and say hoo-hoo.

q: Which animal says baa?
x: Sheep say baa, and their wool makes warm sweaters.

q: Which animal has a long tail and loves bananas?
x: Monkeys love bananas and climb trees with their hands, feet and tail.

q: Which animal can fly?
x: Butterflies fly with four colourful wings.

q: Which animal carries its house on its back?
x: A turtle can hide inside its hard shell.

q: What is a baby chicken called?
x: A baby chicken is a chick. Chicks say peep peep.

q: Which animal lives in the sea and has eight arms?
x: An octopus has eight arms called tentacles.

q: Which animal sleeps all winter?
x: Many bears sleep through the cold winter.

q: Which animal has spots?
x: A ladybug is red with little black spots.

q: Who makes a web?
x: Spiders make sticky webs to catch insects.

q: How many eyes do you have?
x: We have two eyes to see the world.

q: How many fingers are on one hand?
x: Each hand has five fingers.

q: What do we chew food with?
x: Teeth bite and chew our food.

q: Where is your hair?
x: Hair grows on our head and keeps it warm.

q: What helps us think and remember?
x: Your brain is in your head. It helps you think!

q: Which one is a drink?
x: Water is the best drink when we are thirsty.

q: Which fruit is orange and round?
x: An orange is a juicy round fruit.

q: What do bees make?
x: Bees make sweet honey from flowers.

q: Which one do we eat for breakfast?
x: A good breakfast gives us energy for the day.

q: Which fruit has a hard, hairy shell?
x: A coconut has a hard shell and sweet water inside.

q: When it rains, what do we jump in?
x: Puddles are fun to splash in with rain boots!

q: What colour is the Sun in pictures?
x: We draw the Sun yellow because it is bright.

q: What do we see in the sky after rain?
x: A rainbow comes when the Sun shines through raindrops.

q: What makes a kite fly?
x: Wind pushes the kite up into the sky.

q: Where do we take a bath?
x: A warm bath keeps us clean.

q: What do we sleep with at night?
x: A soft pillow helps us sleep well.

q: What do we say when someone gives us a gift?
x: Saying thank you makes people happy.

q: Which one do we play music with?
x: We hit a drum to make a beat.

q: Which one do we wear on our hands when it is cold?
x: Gloves keep our fingers warm.

q: Who brings letters to our house?
x: The mail carrier brings letters and packages.

q: Who flies an airplane?
x: A pilot flies the airplane high in the sky.

q: Who grows our vegetables?
x: Farmers grow food on their farms.

q: What do we put rubbish in?
x: Putting rubbish in the bin keeps our home clean.

q: Which light means stop?
x: Red means stop, green means go.

q: Which one is the tallest?
x: Giraffes are the tallest animals.

q: Which one is long?
x: A snake is long and thin.

q: Which one is heavy?
x: An elephant is very heavy; a feather is very light.

q: Which one is a circle?
x: A circle is round and has no corners.

q: What grows on trees?
x: Trees have green leaves that drink in sunlight.

q: Where do fish live?
x: Fish live and breathe in water.

q: What do flowers need?
x: Flowers need water and sunshine to grow.

q: In which season is it very hot?
x: Summer is the hottest season - time for swimming and ice cream!

q: How do you feel on your birthday?
x: Birthdays are happy days with friends and family.

q: Your friend is crying. What can you do?
x: A hug can help a sad friend feel better.

q: What can we do when we feel angry?
x: Deep breaths help us calm down.

q: Which one is a kind thing to do?
x: Sharing is kind and makes playing more fun.

q: Which one has wheels?
x: Cars roll on four round wheels.

q: Which one carries lots of children to school?
x: The big yellow school bus carries many children.

q: Which one goes to space?
x: Rockets blast off into space.

q: Who rides on a fire truck?
x: Firefighters ride the big red fire truck.
